summary: Week 5 is the first genuine reversal on this account and simultaneously the worst week yet for the service she actually pays for. Volume rebounded hard — 23 messages against 7 last week, 9 of them from Alanna against 2 — and the two things that had been rotting longest both moved. The first invoice finally cleared: after 15 days and four chases, Stephski escalated on 8/30 to an explicit ultimatum ('We will unfortunately have to pause work if it remains unpaid by the morning'), Mayson piled on an hour and a half later, and Alanna posted a payment screenshot at 23:54 with 'Sorry for the late payment'. Stephski then fixed the process defect flagged in the last two reports without being asked: invoice #2 (Aug 15-31) went out 9/1 with an explicit term — 'I ask that you please pay within 7 days to avoid any pausing of work' — and she proactively offered a Zelle request on 9/3. Mica Vecco broke a 28-day total silence on 8/31, producing the first Social Media output in the account's history. That unlocked the best exchange this account has ever had: Alanna asked 'Would it possible to start more instas for me?' and Michelle answered 'yes we are warming up an insta account for you' within 11.5 hours. Against all of that: Ollie Mckinlay, the page and chatting manager, sent ZERO messages across the entire seven-day window. The Aug 29 pinned drop (Lola second scene) — the final date on the release schedule she pinned on day one — passed with no mention by anyone, making three consecutive uncovered pinned drops after Aug 17 and Aug 24. Her pinned schedule is now fully exhausted and nobody has asked her for the next one. Her 8/19 'stop chatting, I'm live' instruction is 16 days unanswered, the chatter FAQ form is 32 days untouched, Derrek has not posted since 8/12 and has delivered zero of the four weekly DMCA reports he promised. The money is flowing and the client is re-engaging, into a delivery vacuum on her #1 stated priority.

health.rationale: Up 5 from 65, the first increase since onboarding, and the increase is real: client volume went 2 -> 9, she initiated an expansion request rather than going quiet, the first invoice cleared, invoicing got a stated due date, and Mica finally appeared after 28 days. The last four tone signals from her were 'Sorry for the late payment', 'Yesss I'm very consistent all my reels go viral!', 'Thanks so much' and 'Yay thanks' — she is warm and buying more, not leaving. It is capped at 70 rather than higher because the core paid service went dark: Ollie sent nothing in seven days, the Aug 29 drop was the third consecutive pinned release with zero coverage, her pinned schedule has run out with no one asking for a replacement, and the invoice only cleared because ALTR threatened to stop working. The relationship recovered this week on the back of promo/social/billing while OnlyFans page management — the thing she is actually buying — produced literally nothing. If Ollie stays absent another week this reverses immediately and harder than it rose.

Marking late=true, days_late 15 measured from issue since the invoice carried no stated due date. First and only completed payment on the account.
